-- Linear congruential step, kept in [0, 2^31).
next_seed(s: int) -> int =
  pre s >= 0
  pre s < 2147483648
  post out >= 0
  post out < 2147483648
  ex next_seed(0) == 12345
  (s * 1103515245 + 12345) % 2147483648

-- Index in [0, n) derived from a seed.
rand_below(seed: int, n: int) -> int =
  pre seed >= 0
  pre seed < 2147483648
  pre n > 0
  post out >= 0
  post out < n
  ex rand_below(5, 1) == 0
  seed % n

-- Returns a permutation of xs whose order depends only on seed.
shuffled(xs: List[int], seed: int) -> List[int] =
  pre seed >= 0
  pre seed < 2147483648
  post out.len() == xs.len()
  ex shuffled([], 7) == []
  ex shuffled([1], 3) == [1]
  var out = copy xs
  var state = seed
  var i = out.len() - 1
  while i > 0
    state = next_seed(state)
    let j = rand_below(state, i + 1)
    let t = out[i]
    out[i] = out[j]
    out[j] = t
    i -= 1
  out

test_shuffled_empty() =
  assert shuffled([], 7) == []

test_shuffled_single() =
  assert shuffled([1], 3) == [1]

test_shuffled_keeps_length() =
  assert shuffled([1, 2, 3, 4], 42).len() == 4

test_shuffled_is_deterministic() =
  assert shuffled([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], 9) == shuffled([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], 9)
